moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing its fifth heatwave of the summer, with temperatures hitting 38.1C on Thursday, August 13th, making 2026 on track to be the warmest summer on record, though cooler conditions are expected over the weekend.

angles.name: Heatwave peak
angles.copy: Another heatwave peaks across the UK! Temperatures soared to 38.1C yesterday, pushing 2026 towards a record-breaking summer. Stay hydrated as it eases off for the weekend.

angles.name: Weekend cool-down
angles.copy: After a scorching week, the UK's fifth heatwave is set to ease over the weekend. Time to enjoy those slightly fresher temperatures!

moments.title: Longest Running UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 this week, marking its 21st non-consecutive week at the top, making it the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time.
